description: This header file declares functions for interfacing with an HD44780 LCD display, including initialization, cursor positioning, character and string printing, and retrieving current cursor position.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_init
methods.description: Initializes the LCD display with shared logging.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_set_position
methods.description: Sets the cursor position on the LCD.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_char
methods.description: Prints a single character to the LCD.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_string
methods.description: Prints a string message on the LCD.

methods.name: getCurrentHD44780row
methods.description: Returns the current cursor row on the LCD.

methods.name: getCurrentHD44780column
methods.description: Returns the current cursor column on the LCD.

methods.name: lcdShowPanicMessage
methods.description: Displays a panic message on the LCD.
